snippet.title: Centurion Explains
snippet.description: Dive into the fascinating universe of the Roman Empire with Centurion! Our channel delivers deep analyses of the emperors, legions, conquests, and daily life of a civilization that redefined the world. In concise, visually rich videos, we unravel the stories behind the names, the tactics behind the victories, and the causes of its greatness and downfall. If you are passionate about history and seek knowledge with a veteran's authority, your journey begins here. Rome awaits!

snippet.title: Historia Militum
snippet.description:
The official rebirth of "Historia Militum" after our 338k-subscriber channel was lost. We create cinematic documentaries on Rome, warfare, and the ancient world. Support us on Patreon to keep the channel alive.

Despite the major setback, our mission remains the same: to bring the ancient world to life with high quality research, accuracy, storytelling, and passion from a fully human team — always free for everyone to watch. Roman history is one of the most enticing topics to talk about, and we always try our best to answer all the question you have with videos no one has seen before. Thank you for standing with us. Only together can we keep Historia Militum alive!

If you wish to support our work and help us rebuild after this setback, you can join our community on Patreon: patreon.com/c/HistoriaMilitum

PBS and our member stations are America’s largest classroom, the nation’s largest stage for the arts and a trusted window to the world. snippet.title: Kings and Generals
snippet.description:
Sponsorship email: info@kingsandgenerals.net

Welcome to Kings and Generals, the premier YouTube channel for anyone interested in military history. Our channel is dedicated to providing high-quality educational content that explores some of the most significant military campaigns, battles, and strategies throughout history.
Our team of passionate historians and military experts are committed to delivering accurate and engaging content that is accessible to viewers of all levels. From the ancient world to the modern era, we cover a wide range of topics with a focus on in-depth analysis and informative discussions.
Our videos feature detailed maps, graphics, and animations that bring historical events to life and make them easier to understand. Kings and Generals is the go-to resource for anyone looking to learn more about military history.
Join our community of history enthusiasts and discover the fascinating world of military history with Kings and Generals.

snippet.title: Metatron
snippet.description:
Hello NOBLE ONES!

Welcome! This is a variety channel. I speak about anything and everything that interests me or catches my attention. Usually this means European history, Middle Ages, ancient Rome, ancient Greece but also politics, political commentary from a moderate right wing perspective, reactions and more. 

In the channel archives you'll find all sorts. Languages, videogames, Medieval weapons and armor, world history and yes I do address culture war topics and religion (I'm a Christian).
It's absolute pure chaos and I love it.  All are welcome to this pandemonium, whether you agree with me or not. 

If anything, I'd say this channel is an expression of the freedom of the mind. 

I upload twice a day. 

Check out my other channels for more specialized single topic uploads.

We break down history’s most fascinating topics — from ancient civilizations and legendary battles to weapons, armor, tactics, empires, and the strange stories you never learned in school.

What you can expect:

Short, powerful videos that explain big topics in 8–10 minutes

Entertaining scripts with humor, sarcasm, and clear structure

1-2 New videos every week

👉 Subscribe and join us as we explain the world, one topic at a time.

Our featured history documentary series include "Moments in History", "How They Did It" and "The Art of War".

Subscribe so you don't miss out.
